hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; recent=$(git log --since="30 minutes ago" --name-only --pretty=format: 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$" | grep -vE "INSIGHTS\.md$"); uncommitted=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "INSIGHTS\.md$"); if [ -n "$recent" ] || [ -n "$uncommitted" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"Stop\",additionalContext:\"Reminder (engineering-insights hook): source files changed recently in this repo. Before finishing, check whether a non-trivial, actionable engineering lesson surfaced this session and, if so, invoke the engineering-insights skill / update the relevant module INSIGHTS.md. If nothing new cleared the bar, doing nothing is the correct outcome.\"}}"; fi
